subject.title: fix(proxy): add error handler on upstream response stream

question: Should the assigned maintainer refresh/port this conflicting proxy PR onto current main now, or wait for the contributor to refresh it?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the live branch conflicts with current main in the same proxy capture files and a bad resolution could drop current body-preview capture behavior.

options.title: Maintainer ports the patch
options.body: Port the `upstreamRes` error handler and test intent onto current main while preserving body-preview capture behavior, then validate the focused proxy test.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Leave the PR open for the contributor to rebase or recreate the branch against current main before another review.

options.title: Close only if maintainer rejects the direction
options.body: Close this PR only if maintainers decide the upstream response stream crash is not worth fixing in the debug proxy.

recommendation.title: Maintainer ports the patch
recommendation.body: Port the `upstreamRes` error handler and test intent onto current main while preserving body-preview capture behavior, then validate the focused proxy test.
